decision.comment: The ablation stage is internally consistent and methodologically sound. Verification: (1) All three scenarios share the common split fingerprint 9afc9ed3…c7505 and seed 42, confirming a fair same-split comparison. (2) The stepwise design correctly isolates normalization (unit→standardize: +12.9 pp accuracy) and then hflip on top of standardize (−0.8 pp), a reasonable decomposition of the representation pipeline. (3) Checkpoint SHA-256s, Lightning CSV paths, and training-log paths are all distinct per scenario. (4) The hflip augmentation is a built-in primitive requiring no extension approval. (5) The ablation's best scenario (standardize_hflip, 0.897772) is below the full-pipeline best (0.917549), consistent with the remaining ~2 pp attributable to brightness and contrast augmentations not tested in this ablation. (6) The slight negative delta from hflip (−0.8 pp vs standardize_only) is within single-seed variance and does not constitute a deterministic defect. No deterministic findings are present. Carried warnings from prior stages (OOD AUROC below chance, non-functional abstention, architecture coverage gap, llm_model_digest null, class-7 recall, validation-test gap) are already documented in the comparison, evaluation, and reporting stages and do not require new action here. The ablation report is a valid, traceable artefact and the pipeline may proceed.
issues: Ablation does not isolate brightness or contrast contributions individually; the ~2 pp gap between standardize_hflip (0.8978) and the full pipeline (0.9175) is attributed jointly to both. Acceptable as a design choice but noted for completeness.

hflip shows a slight negative effect (−0.8 pp) relative to standardize_only under seed 42; with a single seed this is within expected variance and not a deterministic finding, but multi-seed confirmation would strengthen the conclusion.

Carried warnings remain: OOD AUROC 0.183 below chance, abstention non-functional (coverage=0.0), residual_cnn/resnet18 never evaluated, llm_model_digest null, class-7 recall 0.458, validation-to-test gap ~7.3 pp. All previously documented; no new action required at this stage.

request.system: You are an independent software and ML consistency reviewer. Inspect only the supplied evidence. You may raise severity but must never dismiss deterministic findings. No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
